title: Find the Cow
description: Solve clever color-region logic grid puzzles inspired by viral Queens brain teasers—place exactly one cheeky creature in every row, column, and colored zone with no two touching.
controls: Tap grid squares to mark empty cells or place a creature so every row, column, and colored region holds exactly one without touching diagonally or orthogonally.

zh-CN.title: 找牛大作战
zh-CN.description: 超上头的彩色区域逻辑推理棋盘：每种颜色区域、每行、每列有且仅有 1 只目标且互不相邻，步步排除越玩越停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 点击格子标记排除或放置目标，满足每行、每列、每种颜色区域各 1 只且互不相邻即可通关。
